check.py.content_utf8:
from pathlib import Path
from importlib.metadata import version
from spicelib.editor.asy_reader import AsyReader
s = AsyReader(Path("hello.asy"))
print("spicelib",version("spicelib"))
print(s.attributes)
print(s.pins)
assert s.attributes["Value"] == "Hello, World!"
assert len(s.pins) == 2
print(s.attributes["Value"])
